ZAF.note: Digital ID is envisioned only; no authentication service stated.

facts.fact: ITWeb reports the home affairs minister saying the digital ID system will follow eight conditions of South Africa's Protection of Personal Information Act, the country's data privacy law.

ZAF.note: Only a future public consultation is mentioned, none held online.
No enrolment count or share given.
Who operates or maintains the ID system is not stated.
No register keyed on the ID number stated.

facts.fact: ITWeb reports the home affairs minister saying the department is charged with building the first components of the national digital ID system and comprehensive policy work is under way.

ZAF.note: No other system checking against the ID stated.
Consultation is promised for later, not held.
